Khalifa's reinterpretation as a divine numeric signature is exegetical, not numerical.

claim_recap.khalifa_claim: Some unexamined operationalization of Q 74:30 might rehabilitate Code-19
claim_recap.verdict: FAILED. None of 11 reasonable operationalizations yields 19-residue at chance-improbable rate. The single exception (Q 73+74 verse total = 76 = 4×19) is a small-integer coincidence (76 has 5 factor-pairs in [2..38]; the chance any 2-surah verse-sum is divisible by 19 = ~1/19 ≈ 5.3%, no Bonferroni-survival).

summary: Of 13 claim-axes adversarially audited: 3 VERIFIED-TRIVIAL (basmala-19-letters under no-tashkeel only; 114=19×6 arithmetic; surah-96-as-19th-from-end arithmetic — none statistically significant), 1 VERIFIED-TEXTUAL (Q 74:30 contains 'عليها تسعة عشر' as a textual fact, but classical tafsir interpretation = 19 angels guarding Hell, not a Code-19 self-reference), 1 RULES-TUPLE-FRAGILE (basmala-19-letters fails under full-Uthmani-script), 8 FAILED/REFUTED (all corpus-architectural numerology claims null at Bonferroni-corrected α; cumulative 163-test corpus-wide numerology-audit family registers ZERO Bonferroni survivors per H-NEW-237 consolidation). Specialist NEW-operationalization search across 11 reasonable rules-tuple variations of Q 74:30 yields no 19-residue at chance-improbable rate. VERDICT: Code-19 claim from Q 74:30 anchor REMAINS REFUTED across all axes. The Q 74:30 'nineteen' refers to 19 angels (classical tafsir, al-Ṭabarī chain Ibn ʿAbbās), and the surah's structural-architectural signature (UAS rank 54, FR-centroid rank 42, oath-pair with Q 73) is independently characterized at law-strength.
